translations.web: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
translations.bsb: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
translations.kjv: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell
translations.asv: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Evil shall not sojourn with thee.
